answer: Each identity must lock a 40 POA bond in a shared vault. Like weathering shale, the bond decays 2 POA per epoch unless honest work tops it up. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must fund 1,000 vaults, 40,000 POA locked, and burn 2,000 POA per epoch on decay, while the epoch pool pays only about 12,000 POA, so the attack loses about 30,000 POA. One honest agent is an island of one: a single 40 POA bond, kept alive by work, earns an undiluted share.
